events.text:
Done! The pomodoro timer is built and running.

**What I made** (in `pomodoro/` from the web-static template):
- **`index.html`** — big `25:00` countdown display plus Start / Pause / Reset buttons
- **`app.js`** — timer logic:
  - Drift-free countdown (tracks an end timestamp, ticks every 250 ms)
  - Start begins/resumes, Pause freezes, Reset returns to 25:00
  - At zero: status flips to "Time's up!" and a short 880 Hz sine beep plays via the Web Audio API (no audio file needed)
  - The tab title shows the live countdown while running
- **`style.css`** — large tabular-numeral clock (scales with viewport), centered controls, light/dark theme support

**Preview:** running now at **http://127.0.0.1:5300/** — click Start to begin a 25-minute focus session. Note the beep only plays after a user interaction (browser autoplay policy), which is satisfied by clicking Start.
